title: FSB publishes 2026 G-SIB list
summary: Total number of global systemically important banks remains at 29, with two banks moving to different buckets.

title: 2026 List of Global Systemically Important Banks (G-SIBs)
summary: 2026 list of G-SIBs remains at 29, with one bank moving to a higher bucket and one bank moving to a lower bucket.

title: FSB Regional Consultative Group for Asia meets in Sydney
summary: Reserve Bank of Australia hosts FSB Asia group in Sydney.

title: FSB publishes 2026 list of insurers subject to resolution standards
summary: List of insurers subject to resolution standards rises from 17 to 24.

title: FSB sets out its priorities for 2027
summary: FSB members met in Basel to discuss vulnerabilities in the global financial system and the FSB work programme for 2027.

title: Virtual outreach event on FSB Regulatory and Supervisory Modernisation Principles
summary: The FSB will host a virtual outreach event on its proposed principles to assist financial authorities in their modernisation efforts on Tuesday 15 December.

title: Further work by jurisdictional authorities and private sector necessary to enhance cross-border payments
summary: Meaningful progress toward the G20 Roadmap’s goals will depend on effective jurisdictional implementation, public-private coordination, and sustained support from international organisations.

title: G20 Roadmap for Enhancing Cross-border Payments: Consolidated progress report for 2026
summary: Implementation of the toolkits and recommendations developed under the G20 Roadmap for Enhancing Cross-border Payments is progressing, but continued efforts by the public and private sector are required.

title: Financial stability in a rapidly changing world
summary: FSB Chair, Andrew Bailey, discusses the importance of transparency and cooperation in managing systemic risks at the IOSCO Conference celebrating 25 years of standard setting from Madrid.

title: FSB recommends Türkiye further strengthens its regulatory framework for crypto-assets and stablecoins
summary: Türkiye should operationalise a financial stability monitoring framework, establish a regime for stablecoins, strengthen supervision and enforcement, and promote cross-border cooperation and information sharing.

title: Peer Review of Türkiye
summary: Peer review assesses Türkiye’s progress in implementing the FSB recommendations for the regulation and supervision of crypto-asset activities, including stablecoins.

title: FSB Regional Consultative Group for Europe meets in Bern
summary: Swiss National Bank hosts the FSB Europe group in Bern.

title: Strengthening the crisis-preparedness community in an interconnected world
summary: In this speech, Dominique Laboureix, Chair of the FSB Resolution Steering Group, discusses the importance of cross-border, cross-sectoral crisis preparedness.
